Unabridged

This includes the complete Harry Potter Full Cast Edition, encoded in 5.1-channel Opus audio. Each book is provided as a single Opus file with embedded chapters, metadata, cover-art, and grouping inside ogg/vorbis tags.

This was encoded with libopus encoder in 196k-VBR mode, giving the encoder plenty of headroom to allocate additional bits to complex audio passages when needed, using the highest-quality sources available for these editions (Dolby EAC-3 files at 762 kbps). The original surround sound layout was preserved by encoding the audio as 5.1-channel Opus, retaining the surround effects and spatial audio experience of the source. The final files average around 112 kbps. This is thanks to Opus’s high efficiency compared to other codecs, allowing it to maintain almost the same audio quality at a significantly lower average bitrate.

I created this encode a while ago, when the Harry Potter Full-Cast Editions were first released, mainly to save storage space on my home server while preserving as much sound quality and audio detail as possible.

A lot of time and effort has been poured into making this encode, with as much attention to detail as possible, so I’d really appreciate it if people could seed this for the long term. I have limited bandwidth and probably won’t be able to seed it continuously or forever. Thanks!

[About Harry Potter series]

The Harry Potter series follows Harry, an orphan who discovers on his eleventh birthday that he is a wizard and is invited to attend Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. There, he befriends Ron Weasley and Hermione Granger, learns about the wizarding world, and gradually uncovers the truth about his past and his connection to the dark wizard Lord Voldemort.

Across seven books, Harry and his friends grow from young students into determined young wizards as they face increasingly dangerous challenges, uncover long-hidden secrets, and ultimately confront the greatest threat the wizarding world has ever known.

Harry Potter listening order:

1. Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone
2. Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
3. Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
4. Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
5. Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
6. Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
7. Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
